ai.title: Fix abort handling in agent-runtime and SDK run
ai.summary: Agent-runtime stream parsers now wrap consumption loops in try/finally blocks to ensure buffered text is flushed and message history is updated even when an AbortError is thrown mid-stream. The SDK's run.ts removes manual pending response tracking and cancellation context injection, relying on the runtime's robust finalization instead. Scope includes packages/agent-runtime (run-agent-step, tool-stream-parser, tools/stream-parser) and sdk/src/run.ts. This prevents loss of streamed content during user-initiated cancellations.

eli5.text: If you cancel a request while the assistant is reading a response aloud, any text that was already spoken but not yet saved will now still be kept. Previously that text could get thrown away when the cancellation happened mid-answer, leaving the conversation history with a gap. The system now makes sure to record everything that came through before stopping, so you don't end up missing the last part of what the assistant was saying.
